description: Identify Earth Locations that Analog the Permanent Moon Base Locations and Mars
summary:
Wakandax Analog Explorer is an interactive web platform designed to bridge Earth science and space exploration by identifying, mapping, and analyzing terrestrial geological analogues that mimic the extreme environments of the Moon and Mars.

We developed a web-based application that connects Earth-based analogue sites—such as volcanic terrains, hyper-arid deserts, and impact craters—with lunar and Martian mission parameters. The platform addresses the challenge of selecting proper planetary testing grounds by providing a centralized, visual tool to compare environmental and geological metrics side-by-side.

This is crucial for researchers, educators, and space-tech innovators because selecting accurate analogues is vital for pre-deployment testing of rover mobility, astronaut survival training, and in-situ resource utilization (ISRU) before launching actual extraterrestrial missions.
details: Earth Analog Explorer, developed by WAKANDAX, is a mission-specific planetary exploration platform designed to identify suitable Earth environments that resemble conditions found on other planetary bodies, particularly the Moon and Mars. The project recognizes that an environment may appear similar overall but may not be suitable for every scientific or exploration mission. To address this challenge, the platform combines three key features. The Analog Similarity Index (ASI) converts multiple environmental factors into a clear, measurable similarity score, allowing different locations to be compared efficiently. Mission-specific analog matching enables users to define their exploration objectives, prioritize relevant factors, and identify the best-fit Earth analog for a particular mission. Additionally, split-screen comparison provides a direct visual view of Earth environments and planetary targets, making similarities, differences, conditions, and mission relevance easier to understand. Together, these features create a data-driven, mission-aware workflow that supports smarter analog discovery and focused exploration planning.
